10 simple things you can do today to help your weight loss journey🤞🏾

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. videos.caption: Here's how I'm approaching my 30-day fat loss phase 👇🏽. I'm not demonizing food. Halloween candy isn't bad. It's food. And no food needs to be completely off-limits for me to make progress. I'm prioritizing protein and balanced meals. Getting enough protein, carbs, fats, and fibre keeps me satisfied and makes it easier to manage my hunger throughout the day. I'm staying in a small calorie deficit, not starving myself. Fat loss comes down to consistently consuming fewer calories than I burn. I don't need to drastically slash my calories to make that happen. I'm allowing myself flexibility. Some days I might have 3 pieces of candy. Some days I might not want any. Both decisions are fine. I'm focusing on consistency, not perfection. I don't need to hit all my macros perfectly everyday to get results. If my carbs are a bit higher one day but I'm within my calorie range it's all good.  And here's something I wish more women understood. When you spend weeks or months telling yourself you can't have certain foods, eventually the restriction catches up with you. You end up overeating those foods, feeling guilty, and convincing yourself that you're the problem. That cycle isn't a lack of willpower. It's often the result of a plan that leaves no room for flexibility. You can lose fat AND enjoy your favourite foods in the process. Because the goal isn't just to lose weight. It's to build the habits that allow you to easily keep it off. #fitover40 #fatlosstips #weightloss #weightlossjourney  #fatlosscoach
